title: Claude Code: usage
description: Claude Code usage in the selected period. Totals come from the api_request events in Loki; only lines, commits and active time come from Prometheus counters.

list.name: model
list.label: Models with usage
list.description: Approximate list of the models used in the period, from the Prometheus counter: usage in the last 60 seconds may not show yet.

query.query: query_result(sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range]) > 0 or (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range]) unless on (session_id, model, type) last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range] offset $__range))))

list.definition: query_result(sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range]) > 0 or (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range]) unless on (session_id, model, type) last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total[$__range] offset $__range))))

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Sum of the api_request events of the period. Cost in dollars as reported by Claude Code. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: Sum of the api_request events of the period. Input, output, cache read and cache creation. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: API calls
panels.description: Number of api_request events of the period. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Sessions with at least one api_request in the period. Sessions that only report counters are left out. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" [$__range])))

panels.title: Prompts (all models)
panels.description: user_prompt events of the period, including commands such as /model. The model filter does not apply.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="user_prompt" [$__range]))

panels.title: Cache read
panels.description: Cache read / (cache read + input + cache creation), in the api_request events of the period. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) / (sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost by model
panels.description: Sum of the api_request events of the period. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Sum of the api_request events of the period. Input, output, cache read and cache creation. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost over time by model
panels.description: Cost of the api_request events in each interval. The sum of the bars may differ from the total, up or down: the first bar may include events from up to one interval before the start of the period, and the browser splitting the query into parts may leave events out. For exact values, use the totals. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Tokens over time by type
panels.description: Tokens of the api_request events in each interval. The sum of the bars may differ from the total, up or down: the first bar may include events from up to one interval before the start of the period, and the browser splitting the query into parts may leave events out. For exact values, use the totals. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__auto]))
sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [$__auto]))
sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__auto]))
sum (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Sessions with the highest cost
panels.description: The 15 sessions with the highest cost in the period, by api_request events. The id identifies the session and carries no other data. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap input_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap output_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_read_tokens | __error__="" [$__range])) + sum by (session_id) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cache_creation_tokens | __error__="" [$__range]))
sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" [$__range]))

panels.title: Cost by source
panels.description: Cost of the api_request events by query_source: main thread, agents, summaries and titles. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (query_source) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost by effort
panels.description: Cost of the api_request events by effort level. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (effort) (sum_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap cost_usd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Most used tools (all models)
panels.description: The 15 most used tools in the period, by tool_result events. Failures are the events with success=false. The model filter does not apply.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" [$__range]))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="tool_result" [$__range]))

panels.title: API errors and refusals
panels.description: api_error and api_refusal events in each interval. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_error" | model=~"$model" [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_refusal" | model=~"$model" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Completed subagents
panels.description: subagent_completed events of the period, by agent type. The model is the one the subagent used last. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (agent_type) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="subagent_completed" | model=~"$model" [$__range])))

panels.title: Lines changed (approx.)
panels.description: Lines added and removed in the period. Delta per session: last value of the period minus the last one before it, with a new session starting from 0. Approximate: it underestimates a resumed session, because the counter restarts. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(max by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added",model=~"$model"}[$__range])) - max by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added",model=~"$model"}[30d] offset $__range)), 0) or max by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added",model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

sum(clamp_min(max by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="removed",model=~"$model"}[$__range])) - max by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="removed",model=~"$model"}[30d] offset $__range)), 0) or max by (session_id, model) (last_over_time(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="removed",model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Commits (all models) (approx.)
panels.description: Commits made in the period. Delta per session: last value of the period minus the last one before it, with a new session starting from 0. Approximate: it underestimates a resumed session, because the counter restarts. The model filter does not apply.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(max by (session_id) (last_over_time(claude_code_commit_count_total{}[$__range])) - max by (session_id) (last_over_time(claude_code_commit_count_total{}[30d] offset $__range)), 0) or max by (session_id) (last_over_time(claude_code_commit_count_total{}[$__range])))

panels.title: Active time (all models) (approx.)
panels.description: Active time in the period. Delta per session: last value of the period minus the last one before it, with a new session starting from 0. Approximate: it underestimates a resumed session, because the counter restarts. The model filter does not apply.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(max by (session_id, type) (last_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{}[$__range])) - max by (session_id, type) (last_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{}[30d] offset $__range)), 0) or max by (session_id, type) (last_over_time(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{}[$__range])))

panels.title: p95 latency by model
panels.description: 95th percentile of duration_ms of the api_request events in each interval. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (model)

panels.title: p95 time to first token by model
panels.description: 95th percentile of ttft_ms of the api_request events in each interval. The model filter applies.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | event_name="api_request" | model=~"$model" | unwrap ttft_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (model)
